catalog.method: GET https://xraytunnel-config.admin6795.workers.dev/api/config with Accept: application/json, User-Agent: XrayTunnel/1.0, X-API-KEY (fixed app key shipped in the public APK). Each of servers/configs is an AES-256-GCM envelope base64(IV 12 B).base64(ciphertext + 16 B GCM tag) with the fixed 32-byte app key. Result has no download APIs, only decrypted data.
catalog.notes: Live re-run 2026-11-28 11:10 UTC: 1,216 servers, 63 configs, same release/snapshot ids - the live feed churns (1,235 -> 1,233 -> 1,216 across the day); configs byte-identical. The /api/store endpoint on the same worker is only a community listing board, not a catalog. .v2k file decoding is verified by self round-trip only (no real exported .v2k sample yet); file/text routes are delivered in v2ray_injector.py but NOT wired in this catalog-only delivery (engine.py / text_bridge.py / registry untouched). .v2k file route is wired by CAT 103 as well.

files.method: .v2k: V2K1|<flags hex>|<payload>, bit 0 = AES-256-GCM envelope (same key); Xray JSON import; vmess/vless/trojan/ss links. Verified by self round-trip (plain and encrypted, 2/2) and by link round-trips from real catalog servers (5/5). No real exported .v2k sample yet.
